hub.speaker: Market-Tier Local
hub.text: Busy morning for the stalls. Mind the queues -- they move faster than they look.

text_variants.text: Don't see many of you up this tier. Nothing personal in the look -- just not a common one.
You'll want the second queue -- the first one's for out-of-towners. You know how it is.

options.text: Anything on you worth my coin?
